name: 二合一玻璃喷油不滴漏款
description: 一按成雾缓按成线，倒喷两用控油不挂壁，玻璃瓶身可视余量

styleLock.backgroundSystem: three rotating fields only: seamless studio white #FFFFFF for packshots, sunlit cream-and-oak counter #F4EDE1 over warm oak #B9814E for lifestyle, deep charcoal graphic field #23211E with one amber accent #D9A02B for mechanism and spec screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft front-left key with bounce fill, true contact shadows, one controlled specular through glass; warm lifestyle light around 4000K from a window side; skimming side light reserved for macro detail; never flat and never clinical
styleLock.surfaceSystem: warm oak counter #B9814E, worn wooden board, pale stone tabletop #F7F2E9, matte porcelain stovetop #E4DBCB
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, applied only in post-production callout slots; one headline line plus at most two short labels, no dense body copy
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons, empty round tick and cross slots, blank dimension lines with bracket end caps, all in one accent colour #D9A02B
styleLock.presentationRules: one product family throughout: upright body on white, slight downward tilt when misting, steeper tilt when pouring, cap always reading matte rather than glossy, scale stable across the set
noDrift: no mixed fonts and no readable scale numerals inside the frame
no random backgrounds and no cluttered kitchen props
no inconsistent lighting direction between paired or split panels
no glossy cap rendering and no invented mechanism parts
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm kitchen oil-control ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio white #FFFFFF, warm cream #F4EDE1, warm oak #B9814E, deep charcoal #23211E and one amber accent #D9A02B; warm temperature held across every frame; backgrounds rotate between a clean studio field, a sunlit oak counter and a deep charcoal graphic field; lighting system is a soft front-left key with bounce fill, true contact shadows and one controlled specular through glass, with skimming side light only for macro detail; surfaces are warm oak #B9814E, worn wooden board and pale stone #F7F2E9; modern geometric sans-serif reserved for post-production callout slots; thin single-weight line icons with empty tick and cross slots and blank dimension lines; product presented as one stable upright family with a consistent tilt language for mist and pour and a matte rather than glossy cap; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no readable scale numerals, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 白底立体主图，右侧附两枚手持使用小图（一枚朝烤串喷出雾锥、一枚朝沙拉碗倾倒）；002 逆光厨房台面，按压朝浅色沙拉碗喷细雾，只露手臂；003 灶台俯角，慢按成细线淋入煎锅；004 拇指推开翻盖朝电烤盘倒油，右侧两枚圆形机构放大图带箭头；005 深浅两只同款并立于木砧板，四周为带端帽的尺寸标注线与数字；006 家庭餐桌场景，两位成人与一名儿童入镜，产品未清晰呈现；007 左右双栏对比版式，左栏暖橙底配空勾形标记与两张产品近摄，右栏灰底配空叉号与黑白普通瓶近摄，下方为项目符号短主张。品类判定依据：产品为手持按压式玻璃油瓶，无电加热与电机结构，判为家居日用下厨房用品，主产品取按压成雾与缓按成线两用的喷油壶，源提示类目与判定一致，006 的家庭用餐仅是场景延伸而非第二主产品。已剥离内容：原品牌字与包装字标、源图全部英文标题与项目符号主张、瓶身公制与英制刻度数值、005 尺寸标注线上的全部数字与单位、006 可辨识成人面孔与儿童头部、007 的具体对比主张与竞品暗示、任何平台徽章与评分字样；图内文案位一律改为「」占位标签或空白标注槽，事实数值改空白 proof placeholder。
